name: postman-api-testing
description: Advanced Postman API test suite run with Newman: chaining, JWT & cookie auth, schema contracts, workflow loops, business-logic and data-driven tests.

scripts.test: newman run collections/api-testing-showcase.postman_collection.json -e environments/demo.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "API Testing Showcase" --reporter-htmlextra-browserTitle "API Tests" --reporter-junit-export reports/junit.xml
scripts.test:data: newman run collections/api-testing-showcase.postman_collection.json -e environments/demo.postman_environment.json --folder "07 Data-Driven Bookings" -d data/bookings.csv -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/data-driven.html
